triggers.note: walking into the black at the end of the exit hallway loads the next level (Construct Error: handle in the level_exit trigger)

entrances.note: the player appears here, walking out of the black hallway

gates.note: Construct Error: a StaticBody3D blocker stands here while closed (apply_mobile.gd); call open_gate(id) when the encounter's last wave is cleared - the beams fade out, the blocker goes, signal gate_opened(id).

encounters.notes: robots in the yard (the gate itself opens from the spinner's terminal)
Stage 109: the battle on the arena that rises in front of the overlook

terminals.note: the big red button: live once the jet screen has arrived (level.json jets); using it opens the gates in 'activates'

risers.note: the arena starts under the liquid; its platforms surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere - goofy: see assembly.goofy_pose

splash.note: per pad: at each tk in pad.splash a ring of slime droplets bursts from the liquid surface round its footprint (pad.size), up and out under gravity; for 'drips' s after the second, droplets fall off its rim as it climbs (fading rate); all die at the liquid

saws.note: joint k turns its group and every later one about axis through its own pivot by amp_k sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period - lag_k) degrees; the spin group also turns rpm about the axis through the blade centre; kill within radius of the blade centre and 0.7 m of its plane (normal = axis)

stops_on.note: the game calls boss_defeated() (apply_effects.gd) when the mini boss dies

belts.note: a body standing on the deck (within width / length, feet within 0.4 m of it) moves speed * axis m/s; Stage 190: the belt's travel p += speed * k * dt (k 1 -> 0 over stop_time once stopped); cleats at fmod(p, spacing) - spacing along axis; each roller turns sign * p / radius about its local y; the 'surface' material's UV v offset = fmod(-p / spacing, 1) (its tile_m = spacing * cos(pitch): one belt link per cleat)

drive.note: press_profile(): u = (t + phase) mod period; ram offset -travel (u/slam)^2, held, eased back over rise; each stage moves offset * frac; rotor angle = whole-turn cycles + spin-up / peak / coast-down from the impact; the head's glow blinks for 'warn' s before each slam; camera shake within 'shake' m on impact
drive.plasma_note: u offset = rotor angle / 360 * plasma_tiles (it turns with the arms); v offset = -t * plasma_rise - pressed * 0.5 (pressed = -ram offset / travel); opacity = plasma_energy(u) (0 until the impact, 1 while pressed, fading over spin_down); emission x (0.25 + energy (0.5 + 0.6 pressed + flicker) + 1.2 exp(-3 (u - slam)) after the impact)
drive.arcs_note: Stage 157/158: while energy > 0 the arcs layer shows with alpha max(min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)), 0.55 energy) x crackle (ds = u - slam; k = floor(24 t): hash(k) = fract(sin(12.9898 k) * 43758.5453) > 0.35 ? 1 : 0.15), its uv jumping to (fract(0.618 k), fract(0.382 k)); else hidden. The light at 'light.pos' (low: it flashes the deck) = light.energy x 2 x min(1, 1.6 exp(-1.8 ds)) x crackle (the impact only); 'sparks' (chamber centres): effect <id>_Sparks bursts at the impact and the crackles after it

sweepers.note: angle(t) = arm + rpm * 6 * t deg (level yaw convention: direction (sin, cos)); a bar kills a body it overlaps (jump over it), a ball kills within ball_r

lifts.note: stand on it 'wait' s -> it travels (smoothstep, 'duration' s) to the other end; a player in a call zone brings it to that end when it is empty; carries whoever stands on it

jets.note: assembly.jet_pose: home bob -> (player on trigger) fly -> wait (hatch opens; the button terminal goes live) -> press -> back home

floaters.note: per pad: joint offset (0, amp sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), 0), yaw +-yaw, tilt +-tilt (about the deck centre); flame_joint scale y flickers; square decks: deck_size / deck_yaw; sink (Stage 189): a player standing on a deck loads it (assembly.sink_step), at 'hold' s it shudders down (sink_profile x pad sink_depth) and rises back
per pad: joint offset (0, amp sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), 0), yaw +-yaw, tilt +-tilt (about the deck centre); flame_joint scale y flickers

characters.note: spawn the glb at position (yaw deg), play clips.idle looped; while a player is within trigger.radius of trigger.center crossfade (fade s) to clips.alert; bob float.node: y = amp sin(2 pi t / period)

boss_lifts.note: parked at the top; the first time a player enters 'trigger' (or the game calls start_boss_lift(id)) it waits 'delay' s, flashes its lamps for 'warn' s, then descends 'travel' m (smoothstep, 'duration' s) onto the dais and stays: its top (deck_y) is a floor; anyone under it as it lands is pushed out past 'radius'; signal boss_lift_landed(id, boss_spawn) - spawn the mini boss there
